body:
**Clause:** 2017 §20.2 p.592 / 2023 §20.2.
**Normative:** "The $exit control task waits for all program blocks to complete, and then makes an implicit call to $finish."
**Probes:** tests/1800_audit/c20/r20_02_exit_in_program.sv (`program pg; initial begin #1 $exit; end initial #5 $display("PROG2 done"); endprogram` plus a module with `initial #20 $display("LATE");`); informational: r20_02_exit.sv ($exit called from a module).
**Observed** (identical under -g2017 and -g2023): the program probe compiles and runs with rc=0 and prints nothing: `PROG2 done` never appears, so $exit finishes the simulation at once. The module-called form prints only `EX0` (neither `PROG done` nor `LATE`).
**Expected:** `PROG2 done` prints at time 5, then the simulation ends (`LATE` is not printed).

Provenance: build b9441baf (descendant of origin/main 8c95b5cc). Probes on branch m7-1800-audit-c08, tests/1800_audit/c20/. Logs: evidence/ieee1800-audit-c20a-20261019/attempt-06-clean-run/.
title: [IEEE 1800] §20.2 — $exit called in a program does not wait for the program blocks to complete
